en: A vintage black‑and‑white interior view of a traditional Scandinavian room with patterned wallpaper, a tiled masonry stove, long woven rugs on wooden floors, carved wooden bench and chairs, a tall longcase clock, a curtained alcove bed, and decorative shelves on the wall. Captioned text appears along the bottom edge and a small printer's mark is in the lower right corner.
